answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the nadir graph and each risks its bond. Because the haven release is recorded with every signature, the ocean audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm of 20 pays that 150 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
